findings.evidence: Mathlib's `LinearMap.BilinForm.separatingLeft_iff_det_ne_zero` at `Matrix/SesquilinearForm.lean:860` gives exactly the determinant fact used here; this PR's own `IsIsometry.injective` at line 337 already uses the weaker condition.
findings.fix: State the determinant lemma with `hB : B.SeparatingLeft` and expose corresponding `SeparatingLeft` versions of all downstream declarations.
findings.issue: `det_toMatrix_mem_nonZeroDivisors` requires `B.Nondegenerate`, propagating unnecessarily to `isUnit_det_of_nondegenerate`, `toIsometryGroup`, and `bijective`; left separation alone gives the required nonzero Gram determinant.

findings.evidence: `QuadraticMap.polarBilin` is defined under `CommSemiring`/`AddCommMonoid` in Mathlib `QuadraticForm/Basic.lean:220-320`, `BilinForm.isometryGroup` is defined under those hypotheses at `Isometry.lean:110-194`, and the proof only rewrites membership and `polarBilin_apply_apply`.
findings.fix: Generalize the section to `[CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]` (or the weakest hypotheses accepted by the existing proof).
findings.issue: `orthogonalGroup_eq_isometryGroup_polarBilin` unnecessarily assumes `CommRing R`; both group definitions and polarization are available over a commutative semiring.

summary: Two theorem families use stronger algebraic or nondegeneracy assumptions than their proofs require.
